Issue tracker is used for reporting crashes or bugs. New features should be discussed on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/0noB0gBDd91B8pMk) or [suggested in the right Discord channel](https://discord.com/channels/143824995867557888/1019954233900007464).

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Relevant logs and/or screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots or videos to help explain your problem.

## Which version of Pokémon Studio are you using?
You can check the Pokémon Studio version on the application's home screen. We won't provide support for outdated projects. Please do not write "latest" because we need the right version.
